Sam plays baseball with Nina every Thursday. Sam's favorite animal is the cat. Sam thinks history is interesting but a little difficult. Also, the newspaper covered the scandal about the famous actor.
Life is full of small surprises. The weather was snowy that day. The science corner is one of the best places in the city. Also, a biker in a leather jacket stopped at the roadside cafe.
Both of them like soup and milk. There are always many people at the telescope. They took many photos at the telescope. We walked along the riverside path as the sun went down.
Sam and Nina had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the science corner by bike. Sam is going to travel to Sydney in May.
